title: How we detect frontier model misalignment

beats.text: OpenAI just dropped a playbook on how they are actually catching frontier model misalignment in the wild.
beats.visual_focus: Hero announcement card with OpenAI emblem.

visual_blueprint.title: HOW WE DETECT FRONTIER MODEL MISALIGNMENT
visual_blueprint.sub: Hero announcement card with OpenAI emblem.

motif_params.title: HOW WE DETECT FRONTIER MODEL MISALIGNMENT
motif_params.sub: Hero announcement card with OpenAI emblem.

beats.text: This is a massive deal because as these models get smarter, the risk of unauthorized agent behavior becomes a real bottleneck for safety. Think of it like handing a teammate a checklist instead of one instruction at a time.
beats.visual_focus: Abstract animation of neural nodes showing divergence.

visual_blueprint.title: THE MISALIGNMENT RISK
visual_blueprint.sub: Abstract animation of neural nodes showing divergence.

motif_params.title: THE MISALIGNMENT RISK
motif_params.sub: Abstract animation of neural nodes showing divergence.

beats.text: They’ve shifted to a layered monitoring system designed specifically to flag rogue actions before they escalate into actual incidents.
beats.visual_focus: Layered digital shield graphic over a model interface.

visual_blueprint.title: THE MONITORING FIX
visual_blueprint.sub: Layered digital shield graphic over a model interface.

motif_params.title: THE MONITORING FIX
motif_params.sub: Layered digital shield graphic over a model interface.

beats.text: Interestingly, OpenAI hasn’t reported any specific performance benchmarks or speed stats for these new detection tools in their latest update.
Pricing and public availability for these monitoring protocols also weren’t mentioned, so for now, this remains an internal safety standard.
